waitSpec.description: Specifies various parameters for waitFor* actions.

restartAllServers.description:
Set to true to restart all servers belongs
to the cluster/env/app that start/terminate this CloudService
Example: PG and Cassandra respect this to restart all servers
in order to use the new DataStore config when switching to new DB

maxNodeCleanUp.description:
Maximum number of empty nodes to clean up when the service is stopped.
0 effectively disables cleanup, -1 represents uncapped max.

waitForDestroy.description: If set to true {@link CloudService.terminate} would wait for resourced to be completely removed

forceTerminate.description:
Default is false, will block the termination of actively connected cloudService.
If set to true, will skip the check

forceStop.description:
Default is false, will block the stop of actively connected cloudService.
If set to true, will skip the check
